sanskrit_verse:
गन्धोदकतिलैर् युक्तं कुर्यात् पात्रचतुष्टयम् ।
अर्घ्यार्थं पितृपात्रेषु प्रेतपात्रं प्रसेचयेत् ॥२५३॥
transliteration:
gandhodakatilair yuktam kuryat patracatuṣṭayam | 
arghyartham pitrpātreṣu pretapātraṁ prasecayet || 253 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must prepare four vessels mixed with fragrant water and sesame seeds, and offer them respectively to the ancestors for the purpose of honoring the departed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The ritual act derives its validity from alignment with cosmic order and ancestral continuity.
Causation: Proper performance of rites ensures uninterrupted flow between mortal and ancestral realms.
Capacity-based responsibility: Individuals capable of performing rituals bear duty toward maintaining ancestral harmony.
Restoration logic: Ritual offerings restore balance disrupted by death and separation.
Consciousness alignment: Correct intention in offering aligns individual consciousness with ancestral lineage.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person has capacity to perform ancestral rites AND neglects to do so, THEN initiate restorative completion process through family council.
IF ancestral offerings are obstructed without consent, THEN realign causal disruption via corrective ritual protocol under dharma authority.
IF pretapātra is misused or diverted, THEN enforce reintegration through supervised ceremonial correction.
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning familial religious duties, the Supreme Court shall recognize the jurisdiction of Dharma-advisors appointed under Sanatana Vaidika Sampradaya. Responsibility thresholds are determined by ritual capacity and lineage continuity, not civil status alone.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that omission of ancestral rites disrupts sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) in the lineage. Responsibility arises from capacity, not fault. Correction occurs through conscious restoration, not punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Assign qualified family member or priest to execute delayed rite within prescribed time frame.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require declaratory affirmation of intent to uphold ancestral obligations.
Integrity Reintegration: Conduct corrective ceremony under Vedic supervision to restore energetic continuity.
final_declaration: This ordinance proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
